tempting mid-day meals
Casual lunchtime dining is a tasty mid-day booster with our 
Austin Blues BBQ and sandwiches made from Hormel Foods’
Bread Ready line of pre-sliced luncheon meats. With nearly half
of the average family food dollar spent away from home, Hormel
Foods has worked to become a preferred supplier of pre-
portioned, pre-sliced, and pre-flavored items that build repeat
Foodservice business. Foodservice sales were up 22 percent 
in fiscal 2004.
taking time out for taste
Memorable homemade sandwiches start with a visit to our 
Di Lusso Deli Company counter. This premium line of deli
meats, cheeses, and condiments can be found in the deli case
in select markets. Hormel pepperoni is another great choice 
for snacks that deliver taste and satisfaction. Our Di Lusso and
other lines of pre-sliced meats generated double-digit sales
gains in fiscal 2004.

getting a good start
Hormel Foods breakfast meats are great eye-openers, whether it’s
Hormel Canadian bacon, Hormel microwave bacon, Hormel fully
cooked bacon, or the increasingly popular Jennie-O Turkey Store
turkey bacon products. The popularity of Hormel microwave and fully
cooked bacon grew again in fiscal 2004, with sales up 19 percent.
> Any time of day, wherever you are, there’s always a great reason to
choose Hormel Foods. You provide the hunger, we’ll deliver the great
ﬂavor and convenience that keeps you moving throughout the day.
